newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares Puerto Rico, West Virginia disasters.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares Puerto Rico, West Virginia disasters.

text.p: President Clinton on Wednesday declared Puerto Rico and West Virginia disaster areas because of extensive hurricane damage.

After this week's Hurricane Hortense, the White House said federal funding for disaster housing, grants, low-cost loans to cover uninsured property losses for individuals and business owners in Guyama, Loiza, Ponce and Toa Baja.

Because of damage from Hurricane Fran, the White House said similar assistance will also be made availabe in West Virginia to the following counties: Berkeley, Grant, Hampshire, Hardy, Mineral, Morgan, Pendleton.
